title: Optical drive report
description: One burn (or attempted burn) on one drive. File name: drives/reports/<vendor>-<model>/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<short-id>.json. Everything here is published as CC0; leave out anything personal.

model.description: INQUIRY product identification, trimmed (e.g. BD-RW BDR-XD08).

profiles.description: Media profiles the drive reports in GET CONFIGURATION (e.g. CD-R, DVD+R DL, BD-R SRM).

host.description: Operating system and machine, e.g. macOS 26 on a Mac mini M4, or Raspberry Pi OS on a Pi 5.

via.description: Burned on the computer itself or through Krouton Server.

backend.description: What drove the burner: DiscRecording, hdiutil, xorriso, IMAPI2, direct MMC.

type.description: Disc type as the drive reports it (e.g. DVD+R, BD-R).

media_id.description: Manufacturer ID read from the disc (ATIP for CD, MID for DVD and BD).

rated_speed.description: Speed printed on the packaging, e.g. 16x.

sense.description: SCSI sense key/ASC/ASCQ on failure, e.g. 3/0C/00.

tool.description: Software and version that wrote the report, e.g. Krouton 1.0.
